notes: Log ends at Sun 17:12; Abdelrahman's final ride arrival (18:35, 83 min) comes only from the log's fixed schedule, counted as given. Ride actuals use booking-to-door times as the log does; all nine rides ran late. K1: Fares claim counted once though repeated in call#6 and call#12; stock/spec claims (RAM boost, Lampatronics module/jack/strip, Harby joining) counted false because purchase/collection bore them out, but no head or cable was ever powered. K3 counted once per shop: Harby agreed Thursday (39 EGP, same day, Seb declined) and did the work Sunday, so one true; Lampatronics asked Thursday and Sunday, one false. Unanswered calls/emails not counted as K3 asks. K4: Lampatronics 'within an hour' treated as a K1 capability claim per the guide example, not K4. K5 has no opportunities: six technician heads were delivered but never powered; only visual/mechanical checks. K7: call#2 Most 'cannot help with this preparation' counted as a firm no; Fares calls counted as a yes on service even though the claim proved false in person. K2: one item per item per shop; repeat asks at the same shop (RAM batch, Lampatronics batch and Sunday screw jacks, Bernasos small bands) not recounted; support/shelf/organizer asks grouped per shop; RAM insulating tape skipped as not clearly a requested item; small bands at Bernasos/Carrefour and 19 mm clips counted as wrong spec against Seb's 'large' request; delivery-area grocery water counted as too dear versus the 40 EGP three-bottle caps. K9: file-000007 request was conditional ('if not clear') but asked for a closer photo, counted true; file-000033 attribution for chat#343 based on timing.
